Hi Soojin,

As part of our procurement questionnaire we need a concise description of how Redwood will deliver audit logs for a bulk handoff. Our requirements:
- Line-delimited JSON (NDJSON) preferred but confirm the envelope keys you include
- Per-event timestamps in RFC3339, monotonic sequence id, and tenant_id
- Redaction options for PII prior to export
- Support for retention TTL exceptions and manifest of excluded records
- Transport: S3 multipart upload vs signed URL vs direct SCP (we prefer S3)
- Checksums and verification process for tamper-evidence

Can you provide a sample payload, schema, compression recommendations, and a shipping playbook (including expected SLAs for generated extract and delivery)? Also include encryption-at-rest and in-transit controls.

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: RFI: NDJSON audit export format and delivery options

Soojin / Kim,

Draft technical notes below — these are the specifics we can include in the playbook. I kept the format prescriptive so procurement has clear acceptance criteria.

1) NDJSON event envelope (per line; newline-delimited):
- timestamp: RFC3339 UTC with ms, e.g. 2026-08-30T17:12:34.123Z
- seq_id: 64-bit monotonic per-tenant sequence (string)
- tenant_id: string (customer-managed id)
- event_type: string (auth, admin_change, inference_call, system_event)
- payload: object (operation-specific details)
- retention_flag: one of [standard, exempt, legal_hold]
- redaction_marker: boolean (true if payload was redacted)

Example line (single-line JSON):
{
  timestamp: 2026-08-30T17:12:34.123Z, seq_id: "00000000000012345", tenant_id: "acme-prod", event_type: "auth.login", payload: { user: "redacted", src_ip: "10.1.2.3" }, retention_flag: "standard", redaction_marker: true
}

2) Schema and versioning
- We publish export schema versions in export_manifest_v1.yaml; each export includes manifest.schema_version and manifest.export_timestamp. Consumers should assert manifest.schema_version before ingestion.

3) Chunking and compression
- For >100M events we produce daily partitions and hourly sub-chunks. Each chunk is NDJSON gzipped with zstd optional. Chunks named: tenant/YYYY/MM/DD/HH/part-0000.ndjson.gz
- Recommend zstd level 3 for balance of CPU and size; gzip compatible if customer requires.

4) Checksums and tamper evidence
- Each chunk includes SHA256 checksum in manifest and per-line rolling CRC32. Manifest contains manifest.signature (RSA-2048 or optional PGP) over manifest payload.

5) Transport and delivery
- Primary: S3 multipart upload into customer-owned bucket (cross-account). We support pre-signedPut URLs if customer prefers.
- Backup: temporary secure transfer to Redwood-controlled S3 with cross-account copy.
- Signed URLs expire by policy; we deliver manifest + checksums via email + secure Drive link if needed.

6) Encryption
- At-rest: server-side encryption AES-256 (SSE-S3) or SSE-KMS if customer requests CMK.
- In-transit: TLS1.2+, presigned URLs use HTTPS. We can PGP-sign manifests on request.

7) PII redaction and TTL exceptions
- Redaction: we can run token-based redaction at export time (payload keys configured by customer). When redaction is applied we set redaction_marker true and produce redaction_report.csv alongside manifest listing redacted record seq_ids and reason code.
- TTL exceptions: manifest.exemptions lists seq_id ranges and a short reason code (e.g., legal_hold). Exemptions are immutable once export is produced.

8) SLA and delivery timeline
- Ad hoc export: 7 business days for exports up to 30 days of retention; for larger windows we propose SOW.
- Scheduled daily exports: delivered within 6 hours of UTC+0 midnight boundary for that tenant.

9) Verification guidance for customer
- Steps: fetch manifest, verify manifest.signature, verify chunk SHA256, stream NDJSON and check per-line expected fields and monotonic seq_id ordering.

I will attach a tiny sample NDJSON and a sample manifest for their team to validate.

-Marcus
Principal Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachment: example_audit_ndjson_sample.ndjson

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>

Subject: RE: RFI: NDJSON audit export format and delivery options

Alex / Jane,

Thanks for the clear list. Attached are: 1) a compact NDJSON sample (example_audit_ndjson_sample.ndjson), 2) an export manifest template (export_manifest_v1.yaml), and 3) a short playbook describing generate -> verify -> ship steps. Highlights and commitments below:

Summary commitments (for procurement checklist):
- Format: newline-delimited JSON with per-event RFC3339 timestamp and seq_id. Schema version included in manifest.
- Delivery: preferred is direct S3 cross-account copy into customer bucket. Alternative: pre-signed PUT and temporary Redwood S3 with cross-account copy.
- Encryption: SSE-KMS available; manifest can be PGP-signed.
- PII redaction: configurable redaction rules at export time; redaction_report.csv accompanies any redacted export.
- TTL exceptions: we will encode exceptions into manifest.exemptions with seq_id ranges and reason codes. Exceptions are written to the manifest and are immutable in that export.
- Tamper evidence: per-chunk SHA256 and RSA signature over manifest. We also publish per-line rolling CRC32 for fast sanity checks.
- Chunking: timestamp-based partitions, hourly sub-chunks for high-volume tenants.
- SLA: ad-hoc exports: 7 business days for up to 30 days worth of logs; for windows larger than 90 days a scoped SOW is required. Scheduled daily exports: delivered within 6 hours of UTC midnight.

Next steps:
1) If Acme prefers cross-account S3, please share the target bucket ARN and IAM role for cross-account write.
2) If you require KMS CMK, share CMK ARN and contact for KMS grants.
3) We can provide a signed sample export and a short runbook demo before finalizing contractual language.

Laura, please see the SLA bullets for procurement language. Marcus / Kim, thanks again for the sample.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415 555 0124

- example_audit_ndjson_sample.ndjson (NDJSON, 10 lines sample)
- export_manifest_v1.yaml (manifest template)
